rationale: Dorea longicatena continues saccharolytic and proteolytic fermentation. Glucose, lactate, and arginine are primary substrates; arabinose supplements. Mixed-acid fermentation yields butyrate, acetate, formate, and CO₂. Growth is limited by ammonium and arginine nitrogen availability (~9 mmol N/gDW/h vs. 10 mmol needed), supporting ~0.9 /h. Carbon is conserved: 70.5 mmol in covers 34.2 mmol biomass + 36.3 mmol fermentation products.
